notes.title: big update
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

I have released the latest update for the full game! We’ve added medical stations to all levels, removed some assets, and optimized the game as much as possible. I’ve managed to reduce the file size to 11.05 GB for 14 levels, down from 13.14 GB.

In breaking news, I’ll be switching platforms in the future. The game, along with my other projects, will be moving to Epic Games, so I won’t be updating as much on Steam anymore. For now, we’ll see how things progress

notes.title: Update Demo Medkit
notes.content:
Here is an update that will be coming in a few hours.

I have removed all medkits that you need to pick up and have implemented a new system, similar to Half-Life 2. Now, there are medics on the wall, and you simply run to them to get healed. The best part is, you don’t need to press any buttons to heal! When you run to a medic box, you will be healed instantly, and sometimes, you might even get an additional 30 HP. If you’re lucky, you can go over 230 HP. So, no more medkit packs!

notes.title: Update Demo
notes.content:
Demo Update,
I watched a video where someone played the demo, so I have fixed some bugs and issues. Here are the updates:

At the start of the game, you will now have a gun, an axe, and a medkit. A prompt will now appear instructing you to pick up items by pressing the "E" button.

I have added functionality for the "H" button to heal when you are hurt.

I have included a tommy gun at the beginning of the second level.

I noticed two monsters that were bugged, so they have been replaced with a new monster/mutant.

If you record demo gameplay on YouTube, I will be watching! It's fun to see people play the game, and I might even leave a comment! =)

That's the update for today. Enjoy!

Best Regards,
LEMIOUTGAMES
Jacob Jufeili

notes.title: Patch 0.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
Patch 0.2 Release Notes

3 New Weapons:

Introduced a new model for the Colt 1911. 

The Shotgun has been upgraded with a new model. Called model 12 Trench shotgun. with a broken Bayonet.

The Axe has also received a new model. 

Gameplay Changes:
I have  removed the crosshair to challenge your accuracy and enhance immersion.
This change is intended to make the game feel more realistic. Good luck hehe, 

Bug Fixes:
Train Station Bug:
Fixed an issue where players couldn't access the final level. You can now progress to the next level without issues.

Miscellaneous:
Monsters:
Reduced the number of monsters in certain areas for better pacing and balance.

Immersion Enhancements:
Tweaked graphics and lighting to improve overall game immersion and visual experience.
